About Me

Profile module · engineering, software, hardware, data

I’m an Electrical Engineering student at the University of Waterloo especially interested in energy systems, including electric vehicles, battery systems, and smart grids.

My experience spans embedded energy prototypes, low-voltage battery management design, ML-powered analytics, RPA automation, dashboards, and hardware repair. I like building practical systems that can be measured, tested, improved, and eventually deployed in real-world energy applications.
